notes.title: Kickstarter Executive Summary
notes.content:
Dear Stakeholders,

I'd like to start with quoting Warren Buffet:
You only have to do a very few things right in your life so long as you don't do too many things wrong

The Kickstarter campaign didn't reach its funding goal. Perhaps the campaign wasn't the thing done 100% right, but I don't consider it as a thing done wrong either. There were many positives outcomes

 * I prepared a playable demo for you,
 * I had a first voices of feedback, which I use to plan new improvements,
 * I met great people (like Lewis Woodhouse or Renaud Nadeau) who believe in Galactic Merchant and helped me to move the game forward,
 * I developed saves system, which I was pushing off constantly so far,
 * Galactic Merchant community had grown,
 * Many content creators on Youtube and Twitch (including Raptor and Nookrium) has streamed the game, helping to reach new audience,
 * Some publishers has shown me an interest in the game,
 * I showcased the game on Pixel Heaven 2022 and some of you has visited me in person :)


(Original Kickstarter announcement could be found here)

In this message I wanted to assure you that I will be working on Galactic Merchant and hopefully you will see new updates soon.

As a first signs of this you can take advantage of trading hints, which were released recently.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41473279/83051c69df02709fafd206e8e8fb40ccdcaf62d1.png

Happy trading,
- Grzegorz Jaśkiewicz, CEO

notes.title: New features coming, Kickstarter update
notes.content:
The first week of the campaign has passed and I'd like to say that I'm really grateful for all your comments, suggestions, feedback and kind words of support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41473279/e2153fcafae69b25b3c406bf9542772bdecfe8d3.jpg

While it may appear that the campaign is not gaining momentum, there have been a lot of demo downloads, activations and play sessions. Which actually makes me feel really happy for delivering the game you want to play.

A big thanks to Raptor for playing Galactic Merchant and publishing video on his channel. It is a great help for Galactic Merchant to reach his target audience.
I'm continuing to develop the game and there are new big features coming soon.

[previewyoutube=ybKupoQ4iDU;full][/previewyoutube]

Campaign continuation
During the first chapters of the story you obtained B-permit in order to gain access to new star systems to do business with.  Now, you will be able to exercise this new opportunity. Two new star systems: Tau Ceti and Beta Hydri have different economic characteristics and you will have to think hard to gain maximum profits.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41473279/29e2b6acba17efb4abd741cad21bb3c2f32cda83.gif

Expanding story
New chapter is also a place where conflict between Federation and Rebellion intensifies. In the first chapters you were able to support both sides. Now, it will be more difficult to keep several irons in the fire. You will have to decide what your role is going to be in the new world order that is coming.

Save system
It is hard to finish the game on a single run, isn't it? With adding more content, I will be introducing a save system, which will allow you to split the game throughout several sessions or come back to the moment where you made a suboptimal decision.

Supply/Demand mechanics
So you found the best trading route, pushed all your ships there and you are done, right? With the addition of this real-world economical phenomenon the game will be more challenging as you will have to continuously adapt to new conditions as you introduce more ships into your business.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41473279/e85da238099f60a7edc270cd726c35b83a06a5dd.png

Freeplay expansion
Multi-star system trading is also going to be introduced in freeplay mode. I just need to make jump gates working and at prices that star business owners could afford.

All the new features will be available to you as "early features" first, so if you'd like to get a hold of them early. I recommend choosing this tier.

I wish you happy trading and a lot of profits
- Grzegorz Jaśkiewicz

notes.title: Gameplay trailer approved
notes.content:
Hi,

We are happy to announce, that Board of Directors have approved new gameplay trailer for publishing.
In new trailer you can see more polished version of the game and also it reveals more of the gameplay.
You can find new trailer in our Steam page. 

Old trailer still remains available, but it will be decommissioned in future. It might be the last chance to see it, if you still haven't.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41473279/aa6ab8f9cdd458ddda8d31eaca66d97a5fb65a52.png

Steve wishes you happy watching :)

- Galactic Merchant team
